program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    base=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Maximal solid rectangular panels of the panel color, including their symbols.
    panels=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            # Components are separated by background.
            stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]; seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen:
                        seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
            r0=min(a for a,b in comp); r1=max(a for a,b in comp)
            c0=min(b for a,b in comp); c1=max(b for a,b in comp)
            panels.append((r0,c0,r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1))
    n=max(p[2] for p in panels); m=max(p[3] for p in panels)
    shapes=[]
    for r0,c0,ph,pw in panels:
        cells=[(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r0+ph) for c in range(c0,c0+pw) if grid[r][c]!=base]
        shapes.append(cells)
    # Symbols touching an outer edge are moved inward. A symbol touching a side
    # edge is centered along that axis; one touching top/bottom moves one row.
    adjusted=[]
    for cells in shapes:
        rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
        dr=1 if min(rs)==0 else (-1 if max(rs)==n-1 else 0)
        dc=0
        if min(cs)==0 or max(cs)==m-1:
            width=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
            dc=(m-width)//2-min(cs)
        adjusted.append([[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c,v in cells],cells[0][2]])
    out=[[base]*m for _ in range(n)]
    occupied=set()
    for cells,color in adjusted:
        # In the rare overlap case, move the later symbol to the nearest free
        # location, preferring downward displacement as in the demonstrations.
        choices=[]
        for dr in range(-n,n+1):
            for dc in range(-m,m+1):
                moved=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in cells]
                if all(0<=r<n and 0<=c<m for r,c in moved) and not (set(moved)&occupied):
                    choices.append((abs(dr)+abs(dc),dr,dc,moved))
        _,_,_,moved=min(choices)
        for (r,c) in moved: out[r][c]=color
        occupied.update(moved)
    return out
'''
open(base+'/task-eac7a7f6.py','w').write(program)
ns={};exec(program,ns)

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    base=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Maximal solid rectangular panels of the panel color, including their symbols.
    panels=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            # Components are separated by background.
            stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]; seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen:
                        seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
            r0=min(a for a,b in comp); r1=max(a for a,b in comp)
            c0=min(b for a,b in comp); c1=max(b for a,b in comp)
            panels.append((r0,c0,r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1))
    n=max(p[2] for p in panels); m=max(p[3] for p in panels)
    shapes=[]
    for r0,c0,ph,pw in panels:
        cells=[(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r0+ph) for c in range(c0,c0+pw) if grid[r][c]!=base]
        shapes.append(cells)
    # Symbols touching an outer edge are moved inward. A symbol touching a side
    # edge is centered along that axis; one touching top/bottom moves one row.
    adjusted=[]
    for cells in shapes:
        rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
        dr=1 if min(rs)==0 else (-1 if max(rs)==n-1 else 0)
        dc=0
        if min(cs)==0 or max(cs)==m-1:
            width=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
            dc=(m-width)//2-min(cs)
        adjusted.append([[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c,v in cells],cells[0][2]])
    out=[[base]*m for _ in range(n)]
    # Resolve direct overlaps by moving the larger symbol downward.
    placed=[]
    for cells,color in sorted(adjusted,key=lambda x:len(x[0])):
        placed.append((cells,color))
    for i,(a,ca) in enumerate(placed):
        for j,(b,cb) in enumerate(placed):
            if i<j and set(a)&set(b):
                moved=[(r+1,c) for r,c in b]
                placed[j]=(moved,cb)
    for cells,color in placed:
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=color
    return out
